bytes are passed to the UART receive handler as an HDLC-framed spinel packet."}, {"step": 2, "file": "src/ncp/hdlc.cpp", "function": "ot::Hdlc::Decoder::Decode", "line": 256, "var": "decoded frame", "code": "mFrameHandler(mContext, error);", "note": "HDLC decoder strips flag bytes (0x7E) and escape bytes (0x7D), validates FCS, and delivers the raw spinel frame to NcpUart::HandleFrame."}, {"step": 3, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_uart.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpUart::HandleFrame", "line": 267, "var": "frame buffer", "code": "NcpBase::HandleReceive(aFrameBuffer, aFrameLength);", "note": "The decoded spinel frame is forwarded to NcpBase for command dispatch."}, {"step": 4, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_base.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpBase::HandleReceive", "line": 354, "var": "header byte", "code": "error = HandleCommand(header);", "note": "Reads the spinel header byte (0x80 = SPINEL_HEADER_FLAG | IID 0), then dispatches to HandleCommand."}, {"step": 5, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_base.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpBase::HandleCommand", "line": 870, "var": "command", "code": "error = CommandHandler_PROP_VALUE_update(aHeader, command);", "note": "Command byte 3 (SPINEL_CMD_PROP_VALUE_SET) is matched, routing to the property-value update handler."}, {"step": 6, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_base.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpBase::CommandHandler_PROP_VALUE_update", "line": 1212, "var": "propKey", "code": "error = HandleCommandPropertySet(aHeader, static_cast<spinel_prop_key_t>(propKey));", "note": "Reads the packed unsigned integer property key (0x1807 = SPINEL_PROP_MESHCOP_COMMISSIONER_GENERATE_PSKC) and dispatches to the property-set handler."}, {"step": 7, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_base.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpBase::HandleCommandPropertySet", "line": 976, "var": "handler", "code": "error = (this->*handler)();", "note": "FindSetPropertyHandler matches SPINEL_PROP_MESHCOP_COMMISSIONER_GENERATE_PSKC to HandlePropertySet_SPINEL_PROP_MESHCOP_COMMISSIONER_GENERATE_PSKC."}, {"step": 8, "file": "src/ncp/ncp_base_ftd.cpp", "function": "ot::Ncp::NcpBase::HandlePropertySet_SPINEL_PROP_MESHCOP_COMMISSIONER_GENERATE_PSKC", "line": 776, "var": "passPhrase, networkName, extPanIdData", "code": "SuccessOrExit(error = otCommissionerGeneratePskc(passPhrase, networkName, reinterpret_cast<const otExtendedPanId *>(extPanIdData), &pskc));", "note": "Spinel decoder reads three fields from the frame: a null-terminated UTF-8 passphrase, a null-terminated UTF-8 network name (100 bytes of 'A'), and a data blob with length prefix (8 bytes of 0x11 for extended PAN ID). These are passed directly to the API."}, {"step": 9, "file": "src/core/api/commissioner_api.cpp", "function": "otCommissionerGeneratePskc", "line": 189, "var": "aNetworkName", "code": "return ot::MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc(aPassPhrase, aNetworkName, *aExtPanId, *aPskc);", "note": "The attacker-controlled network name string is forwarded unchanged to the internal GeneratePskc method."}, {"step": 10, "file": "src/core/meshcop/commissioner.cpp", "function": "ot::MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc", "line": 1107, "var": "salt", "code": "uint8_t salt[OT_PBKDF2_SALT_MAX_LEN];", "note": "A fixed-size stack buffer of 30 bytes (OT_PBKDF2_SALT_MAX_LEN) is allocated for the PBKDF2 salt."}, {"step": 11, "file": "src/core/meshcop/commissioner.cpp", "function": "ot::MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc", "line": 1115, "var": "salt + saltLen", "code": "memcpy(salt, saltPrefix, strlen(saltPrefix));", "note": "6-byte prefix 'Thread' is copied into salt; saltLen becomes 6."}, {"step": 12, "file": "src/core/meshcop/commissioner.cpp", "function": "ot::MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc", "line": 1118, "var": "salt + saltLen", "code": "memcpy(salt + saltLen, aExtPanId.m8, sizeof(aExtPanId));", "note": "8-byte extended PAN ID is copied; saltLen becomes 14. Remaining capacity: 30 - 14 = 16 bytes."}, {"step": 13, "file": "src/core/meshcop/commissioner.cpp", "function": "ot::MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc", "line": 1121, "var": "salt + saltLen", "code": "memcpy(salt + saltLen, aNetworkName, strlen(aNetworkName));", "note": "NO BOUNDS CHECK: strlen(aNetworkName) = 100 bytes is copied into salt starting at offset 14, but only 16 bytes remain. This writes 84 bytes past the end of the 30-byte salt buffer, causing a stack-buffer-overflow."}]
TRACE_EOF
echo "Trace created"
